name: liamklyneker
description: Liam Klyneker's personal Claude Code skills, packaged as installable plugins

plugins.name: prd-workflow
plugins.description: PRD-to-merge workflow for Claude Code: turn context into a PRD, slice it into tracer-bullet issues, pick the next one, run the whole thing end-to-end with a per-issue worker subagent, and triage the QA findings that come back into cold-runnable issues

plugins.name: figma-tools
plugins.description: Figma design-to-spec extraction for Claude Code: reads a Figma file region by region and produces implementation-ready page/gap specs, backed by the figma-region-extractor subagent

plugins.name: ado-workflow
plugins.description: The PRD-to-merge workflow brought to Azure DevOps for Claude Code: publish a spec, slice it into tasks, pick the next one, and run the whole thing end-to-end with a per-task worker subagent

plugins.name: lk
plugins.description: Liam Klyneker's personal Claude Code skills: the grills that interview a plan until every branch is resolved, plus pinpoint, scoped-context and his writing voice — the ones that talk to the user and the codebase rather than to a tracker

plugins.name: install-skills
plugins.description: Bootstrap a project's `.claude/project/adapter.md` for a skill bundle, and diagnose an install that has rotted — the two jobs no distribution mechanism can do for you. Start here: the PRD and ADO workflows cannot run without the adapter it writes
